dataset.name: RealWorldQA content-blind validation sample
dataset.prompt: benchmark-native question and options; answer-letter-only suffix
dataset.promptTemplate:
Question: <question>
Options:
A. ...
Please select the correct answer from the options above.
dataset.orderPolicy: cases deterministically shuffled; provider order uses a balanced 4-position Latin rotation

reproducibility.retryPolicy: up to three attempts for transport/runtime failure only; valid wrong answers are never retried

resourcePacing.note: Pacing changes wall-clock duty cycle only; model, prompt, generation and scoring settings remain frozen.
